0.5476 Olin Common Stock per Huntsman share (Exchange Ratio); cash in lieu of fractional shares (Fractional Share Consideration) calculated as the product of the fractional share interest in a Huntsman share and the VWAP-based price; Unpaid Dividends (dividends or other distributions to which holders become entitled). No CVRs or other forms of consideration are identified in the provided excerpts.
Under the Direct Merger, each Huntsman Common Stock share outstanding at the Effective Time shall be converted into the right to receive 0.5476 shares of Olin Common Stock (the Exchange Ratio) as the Merger Consideration, with any fractional share settled in cash pursuant to Section 3.03(d); the Exchange Ratio and related Merger Consideration are subject to adjustment for changes in Huntsman or Olin stock as described in Section 3.01(d).
